[[Deldrimor Maul (unique)|Deldrimor Maul]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] traded by the [[Artisan of Steel]], a [[collector]] who can be found in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage]] 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:Health +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the non-unique [[Deldrimor Maul]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Deldrimor Maul]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Hammer Haft]]
*Perfect [[Hammer Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Perfect "[[Inscription|Strength and Honor]]" inscription
